facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, represented by National Commissioner and CEO Dr. Vincent Olatunji, co-signed an international data protection authorities' joint statement released 23 February 2026.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission, led by National Commissioner and CEO Dr. Vincent Olatunji, is acting as a data protection authority, co-signing a joint statement on 23 February 2026.
